prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a NEW STRICTLY MINIMALISTIC Android coffee brewing app screenshot for StarlitCoffee.
Output is exactly ONE portrait, full-screen flat app UI, roughly1024x2048. No device frame, perspective, background board, presentation title, branding banner, shadow or marketing slogan.
This request is a corrective design exploration: previous concepts were too decorated, card-heavy, labelled and crowded. Use the visual restraint of a beautifully typeset simple stopwatch.
Flat uniform near-black #171719 background, warm off-white text, restrained pale-lilac accent used only for the ONE primary button. Simple sans serif, very large light-weight tabular numerals, crisp alignment. Native practical readable48dp controls. A small normal status bar and quiet app header. Deliberate generous breathing room, balanced hierarchy. No section boxes or containers.
ABSOLUTELY NO cards, borders around sections, timer rings, progress bars, chips, pills, badges, colored status dots, panel grids, illustrations, coffee beans, kettles, vessel drawings, emoji, decorative icons, step timeline, bottom tabs, onboarding, decorative dividers, gradients, faux shadows, scientific facts, warning banners or recipe-summary tiles. Only back arrow and overflow/chevron icons where functional.
A second running cold brew must remain independently accessible through ONE small text row near the bottom. That background timer is functional, not a card. No global stop-all control, no cold-brew pause. Opening help or ending a foreground timer never implies stopping cold brew.
Render ONLY the specified copy and functional controls. Do not add explanatory prose or duplicate actions.
Scenario: the most basic timer with an independent cold brew concurrently running.
Quiet header: back arrow, "Coffee timer", tiny overflow dots at right. No giant bold app bar.
Main focal point, spacious center: huge light-weight "00:18", a small "Elapsed" label immediately underneath. Nothing else around the clock.
Lower content: ONE medium width pale-lilac softly rectangular button with12dp radius labelled "Pause". A quiet text action "End timer" below it. These controls apply only to Coffee timer. No duplicate pause/play icon.
At bottom above Android gesture handle: subtle plain-text clickable row "Cold brew" left, "12 h 37 m left" right, small chevron. Small label under cold brew name "Until reminder" if needed for clarity. This is an independent running brew. Tiny text link "All timers · 2" just above this row, no large action panel. Timer management including add timer is accessible through that overview/overflow, no extra button.
Everything fits, complete bottom row visible. Main timer dominates; other timer is clearly present but quiet. Natural restrained polished UI.
